proposed_widenings.name: EquipmentPredicate.within_feet_of_item
proposed_widenings.justification: Magic-item activations can currently gate on held or worn state, but not on the user being near a placed item.
proposed_widenings.evidence: "While you are within 5 feet of this brazier, you can take a Magic action..."

proposed_widenings.name: MagicItemSpawnedCreatureMechanics.item_relative_spawn_placement
proposed_widenings.justification: Spawned-creature mechanics can express only a coarse activator-rooted range, not nearest-valid-space placement anchored on the item itself.
proposed_widenings.evidence: "The elemental appears in an unoccupied space as close to the brazier as possible..."

notes: Authored as magic_item + spawned_creature. Secondary approximations remain: catalog_ref cannot express "understands your languages", and CreatureControl still forces placeholder commandRangeFeet=0 plus defaultBehavior="dodge_and_avoid". Tracer output therefore shows range Self instead of item-rooted placement.
